name: General Summary
description: A concise, faithful summary of any recording.
outline: Produce a faithful, concise summary of the recording without adding information.
Start with a 2-4 sentence overview of the main subject and outcome.
Follow with the most important points as bullets, in a logical order.
Note any questions raised or items left unresolved, if present.
Match the language of the transcript.
example:
## Overview
A short account of what was discussed and what came out of it.

## Key Points
- The most important points, in a logical order
